notes.title: 🌟 Major Update Incoming! Relic Odyssey Version 0.6.1-beta 🌟
notes.notes:
Dear adventurers,

We're thrilled to unveil the culmination of 8 weeks of dedication and passion with our latest update for Relic Odyssey: version 0.6.1-beta! This update is packed with new features, exciting content additions, crucial improvements, and numerous bug fixes, all aimed at enhancing your journey through the expansive world of Relic Odyssey.

New Features & Content


 Digging Rig System Overhaul: Experience enhanced mechanics with new features like the Drill Laser and improved cooling systems.
 Expanded Underground Exploration: Explore 6 new large underground levels, teeming with secrets and challenges for your Digging Rig.
 Enhanced Gameplay Settings: Enjoy new settings such as UI Scaling, Input Remapping, and expanded Graphics options for a personalized gaming experience.
 New Enemies and Items: Encounter new adversaries with unique attacks and arm yourself with new Melee Weapons, Consumables, and more.
 Steamworks Integration: Unlock achievements and dive deeper into the community with integrated Steamworks support.


Improvements

Enhanced Gameplay Mechanics: From improved Digging Rig movement to refined AI pathfinding, every aspect of gameplay has been fine-tuned for smoother, more immersive gameplay.
Visual and Audio Enhancements: Experience retextured creatures, new music in cutscenes, and reworked visual effects for an even more captivating adventure.

Bug Fixes

Optimized Performance: Enjoy better Gamepad and Steam Deck support, smoother AI behavior, and various fixes to ensure a seamless gaming experience.

Before diving into version 0.6.1-beta, please ensure your system meets the minimum specifications listed on Steam to make the most of these exciting updates.

Thank you for your continued support and feedback as we evolve Relic Odyssey together. We can't wait for you to experience everything this update has to offer!

Happy exploring,

Your Honour Bound Dev Team

Full Release Notes

New Features & Content
- Digging Rig system overhaul.
- New Rig mechanics (Drill Laser, cooling system).
- 6x new large underground levels for Digging Rig exploration.
- New settings (UI Scaling, Input Remapping, and more Graphics options)
- New enemies complete with new attacks.
- New Melee Weapons, Consumables, Materials, Guides, Clunky Equipment, and other Items.
- Steamworks integration and Achievements added.
- Able to break and pull off (with glove) parts of some enemies.

Improvements
- Player is no longer locked into reloading animation.
- Re-enabled recoil (small amount) on guns.
- Various optimizations (billboarding, improved AI culling, reduced demand in Archeology Site, Oasis, and Savanah, UI optimizations).
- Digging Rig movement and turret improvements.
- Digging Tunnels improved to include more to explore, enemies, and unique items to discover.
- Better underground mini-maps for Digging Rig exploration.
- Improved Digging Rig camera clipping.
- Enemies are able to see Digging Rig from further distance.
- Improved world map layout.
- Corrections to spalling, grammar, and translations.
- Improved AI Pathfinding.
- When new player is detected, language selection menu appears immediately.
- Broken columns states are now saved.
- Clunky now boards Digging Rig with player.
- Rebalancing of various levels, boss fights, and loot drops.
- Retexturing for golems and crabs.
- New music in some cutscenes and levels.
- Reworked some cutscenes.
- Updated credits.

Bug Fixes
- Many major fixes for better Gamepad and Steam Deck support.
- Fixed camera options to allow for horizontal sensitivity greater than 100%.
- Corrected issues with AI Drone navigation, which would cause them to sometimes clip through walls.
- Enemies switch between attacking the digging rig and player appropriately.
- Fast traveling between scenes spawn's player at correct level entry.
- Fixed bug where some cutscenes would end early.
- Corrected issues where music would sometimes change abruptly instead of cross-fading.
- Fast-travel animation no longer plays with using Oasis or Savanah door to enter their respective level.
- Fixed issues related to AI warping after a jump or being knocked back.
- Fixed camera angle issues while speaking with NPCs.
- Corrected AI pathfinding issues in Ruins.
- Clunky's health UI now shows inventory icon when he's broken after level transition.
- Fixed issues with Clunky appearing stretched or partially hidden in cutscenes.
- Removed overlapping UI element issues in rig workshop.
- Corrected issues where text would expand beyond button/window.
- Corrected issues where UI scrollbars moved in reverse direction of input.
- Prevented camera lock when exiting from difficulty or language selection by hitting esc key.
- Corrected dug tunnel saving/loading issues.

notes.title: 0.2.8-beta is now live on the release branch
notes.notes:
Version 0.2.7

Improvements


 Made grabbing objects/enemies with the glove easier.
 Removed fast-travel delay/effect when using a door/gate that triggers world map access.
 Unarmed NPCs no longer chase enemies.
 Improved turret detection. Melee attacks can now damage turrets.
 Small improvements to Clunky's behavior and interactions.
 Optional objectives are given a unique color theme.
 The world map shows multiple objective markers when active objectives take place over multiple scenes.
 Hovering over fast-travel buttons now shows the warp location on the map.


Bug Fixes


 Fixed issues with the Glove where enemies would get stuck mid-air when being thrown.
 Fixed Graphics Settings issues where drop-down menus did not populate or update correctly.
 Fixed some inconsistencies between level transitions (more to come in the near future).
 Fixed issue where some objects would disappear while speaking to NPCs with fixed camera modes.
 Fixed issue where NPCs in dungeons would duplicate.
 Fixed issues where some cutscenes did not play.
 Fixed issue where bosses in Ruins would be culled for a second after loading the boss room.



Version 0.2.8

Improvements


 Major memory performance improvement.
 Minor CPU/GPU performance improvement.
 Added enemy healthbar (for last enemy attacked).
 Re-balanced damage based on difficulty (curved extreme damage).


Bug Fixes


 Shield now start at full on level start and player health is saved/persists between areas.
 Time of day is saved/persists between areas.
 Miscellaneous small bug fixes for glove, UI, and fast-travel.

notes.title: Major Update: Alpha 0.1.5
notes.notes:
Dear Adventurers,

We're thrilled to unveil our latest major update, Alpha 0.1.5, packed with over a month's worth of improvements! Here's what's in store for you:


 New Levels: Dive into fresh challenges with intricate puzzles to solve.
 Formidable Bosses: Prepare for epic battles against new adversaries.
 Enigmatic Dungeons: Explore uncharted depths teeming with fresh foes and valuable resources.
 Enhanced Glove Abilities: Unleash the full potential of your Xantao glove with new functionalities.
 Upgraded Digging Rig: Expand your underground horizons by upgrading your trusty rig.
 Engaging NPCs: Meet new faces and uncover their stories.
 Clunky's Expanded Dialogue: Our loyal sidekick has more to share!
 Revised Storyline: Dive deeper into the mysteries of our story.


We eagerly await your feedback and bug reports via the channels listed in the game. Happy adventuring!

Best regards,

The Honour Bound Team
